sections.title: Day 26 學習概覽
sections.markdown:
今天承接 Day 25，開始把難度推向 **900 分題型**。主軸是 **Part 4 多條件圖表＋說話者意圖**、Reading **Double Passage 修改／取消／重新安排資訊追蹤**；文法則進入高頻但非常容易混淆的：

> **although / even though / while / whereas / despite / in spite of**

由於目前沒有 Day 25 的實際作答紀錄，今天先維持 **860～900 分**，但推論題與同義改寫比昨天再增加一些。建議約 **95～105 分鐘**。

sections.title: ② 今日文法｜although / even though
sections.markdown:
兩者都是：

> **雖然／儘管**

後面必須接：

> **S + V**

例如：

> **Although the shipment was delayed**, it arrived before Friday.

結構：

> although + 子句

`even though` 語氣通常更強：

> **Even though the price was high**, the product sold well.

sections.title: ③ despite / in spite of
sections.markdown:
意思也接近：

> 儘管

但是後面通常接：

> **名詞 / 名詞片語 / V-ing**

例如：

> **Despite the delay**, the shipment arrived Friday.

> **In spite of the bad weather**, the event continued.

不能：

> despite the shipment was delayed ❌

因為：

> the shipment was delayed

是完整子句。

sections.title: ④ although vs. despite
sections.markdown:
這是 Part 5 超高頻秒殺題。

### A

> _____ the weather was poor, the event continued.

後面：

> the weather was poor

完整 S + V。

答案：

> **Although**

### B

> _____ the poor weather, the event continued.

後面：

> the poor weather

名詞片語。

答案：

> **Despite**

所以不要只背中文。

看到空格後先判斷：

> **句子還是名詞？**

sections.title: ⑤ while
sections.markdown:
`while` 有兩個重要意思。

### 時間

> Please wait **while I check your reservation**.

= 當我確認預約時。

### 對比

> Online sales increased, **while store sales declined**.

= 網路銷售增加，**而**實體店銷售下降。

TOEIC 很常考第二種。

sections.title: ⑥ whereas
sections.markdown:
`whereas` 幾乎專門表示：

> **然而／相較之下**

例如：

> Model A costs $300, **whereas** Model B costs $450.

兩件事情形成對比。

後面也是：

> S + V

sections.title: ⑦ 六個連接詞快速分類
sections.markdown:
| 表達 | 後面 |
|---|---|
| although | S + V |
| even though | S + V |
| while | S + V |
| whereas | S + V |
| despite | 名詞 / V-ing |
| in spite of | 名詞 / V-ing |

考場先看：

> **空格後面的結構**

再看語意。

sections.title: ⑧ Part 5 進階陷阱
sections.markdown:
> _____ being more expensive, Model B is our best-selling product.

(A) Although  
(B) Despite  
(C) Whereas  
(D) Even though

後面：

> being more expensive

不是完整 S + V。

所以：

**B**

---

> _____ Model B is more expensive, it remains our best-selling product.

後面：

> Model B is...

完整句。

所以：

**Although / Even though**

sections.title: ⑨ Listening｜Part 4 多條件圖表
sections.markdown:
### Meeting Rooms

| Room | Capacity | Equipment | Available |
|---|---:|---|---|
| A | 8 | Screen | 9–12 |
| B | 12 | Screen + Video | 1–5 |
| C | 20 | Screen + Video | 9–3 |
| D | 30 | Screen | 2–5 |

### Q1

Why is the speaker calling?

(A) To cancel a meeting  
(B) To reserve a meeting room  
(C) To repair equipment  
(D) To invite an employee

### Q2

What does the speaker need?

(A) Space for 15 people and video equipment  
(B) Space for 30 people  
(C) A room available after 3 P.M.  
(D) A room without a screen

### Q3

Which room should be reserved?

(A) Room A  
(B) Room B  
(C) Room C  
(D) Room D

聽力稿：

> Hi, I'm organizing a training session for fifteen employees next Tuesday. We'll need to show several training videos, and the session is scheduled from ten in the morning until noon. Could you reserve the smallest room that can accommodate us and has the equipment we need?

答案：

**1B / 2A / 3C**

條件：

> 15 people  
> video  
> 10–12

Room C：

> 20 + video + 9–3

全部符合。

sections.title: ⑩ Listening｜Part 4 意圖推論
sections.markdown:
### Q1

Why is the speaker calling?

(A) To change an appointment  
(B) To order equipment  
(C) To apply for a position  
(D) To complain about an invoice

### Q2

Why is Tuesday inconvenient?

(A) The speaker will be traveling  
(B) A client meeting was scheduled  
(C) The office will be closed  
(D) The manager is unavailable

### Q3

Why does the speaker say, “Wednesday would actually be even better”?

(A) She wants to cancel completely  
(B) Wednesday is more convenient than the proposed alternative  
(C) Wednesday is a holiday  
(D) She needs a longer appointment

聽力稿：

> Hello, this is Julia Park. I'm scheduled to meet Mr. Chen at two o'clock Tuesday, but a client meeting has just been added to my calendar. I noticed in your earlier message that Wednesday afternoon was also available. Wednesday would actually be even better for me, so please move the appointment if that time is still open.

答案：

**1A / 2B / 3B**

`even better`：

不是單純「很好」。

而是：

> **比原本選項更適合。**

sections.title: ⑪ Listening｜Part 4 圖表＋推論
sections.markdown:
### Workshop Schedule

| Workshop | Time | Fee |
|---|---|---:|
| Excel | 9:00–11:00 | $90 |
| Presentation | 10:00–12:00 | $110 |
| Data Analysis | 1:00–4:00 | $160 |
| Leadership | 2:00–5:00 | $180 |

### Q1

What is the speaker discussing?

(A) Employee training  
(B) Customer refunds  
(C) Travel expenses  
(D) Product prices

### Q2

What restriction does the speaker mention?

(A) She cannot attend in the morning  
(B) Her training budget is $170  
(C) She needs a one-hour course  
(D) She cannot use Excel

### Q3

Which workshop will she most likely attend?

(A) Excel  
(B) Presentation  
(C) Data Analysis  
(D) Leadership

聽力稿：

> My supervisor approved up to $170 for professional training this month. Since I have client appointments throughout the morning, I'll need an afternoon session. I'd especially like to improve my ability to interpret sales figures and customer trends. Please register me for whichever course best meets those requirements.

答案：

**1A / 2B / 3C**

條件：

> afternoon  
> ≤ $170  
> sales figures / trends

→ Data Analysis $160.

Leadership 是下午，但：

> $180 ❌

sections.title: ⑫ Reading｜Double Passage：修改資訊追蹤
sections.markdown:
限時：

**5 分鐘。**

### Passage 1 — Original Schedule

> **Regional Sales Meeting — September 29**
>
> 9:00 — Opening Remarks  
> 9:30 — Quarterly Sales Review  
> 10:30 — Coffee Break  
> 11:00 — Marketing Strategy Presentation  
> 12:00 — Lunch  
> 1:30 — Product Demonstration  
> 3:00 — Regional Planning Session
>
> The meeting will take place in Conference Room 4 at the Weston Business Center.

### Passage 2 — Updated E-mail

> **To:** Meeting Participants  
> **Subject:** Changes to September 29 Meeting
>
> Due to a scheduling conflict, two changes have been made to Tuesday's regional sales meeting.
>
> First, the Marketing Strategy Presentation will now take place immediately after lunch. The Product Demonstration will follow it at 2:30 P.M.
>
> In addition, Conference Room 4 is undergoing maintenance, so the entire meeting has been moved to Conference Room 7.
>
> All morning sessions, including the Quarterly Sales Review, will take place at their originally scheduled times.
>
> Please use the revised agenda attached to this message.
>
> —Karen

### Q1

What was originally scheduled for 11 A.M.?

(A) Quarterly Sales Review  
(B) Marketing Strategy Presentation  
(C) Product Demonstration  
(D) Regional Planning Session

### Q2

What has caused one of the changes?

(A) A customer complaint  
(B) A scheduling conflict  
(C) A speaker resigned  
(D) A transportation delay

### Q3

When will the Marketing Strategy Presentation now occur?

(A) 10:30  
(B) 11:00  
(C) Immediately after lunch  
(D) 2:30

### Q4

What will take place at 2:30?

(A) Lunch  
(B) Marketing Strategy Presentation  
(C) Product Demonstration  
(D) Quarterly Sales Review

### Q5

Where will the meeting be held?

(A) Conference Room 4  
(B) Conference Room 7  
(C) The cafeteria  
(D) Another building

### Q6

Which session is explicitly unchanged?

(A) Marketing Strategy Presentation  
(B) Product Demonstration  
(C) Quarterly Sales Review  
(D) Afternoon Planning

### Q7

What should participants rely on for the most current information?

(A) The original announcement  
(B) The revised agenda  
(C) Last quarter's schedule  
(D) The building directory

**答案：1B / 2B / 3C / 4C / 5B / 6C / 7B**

sections.title: ⑬ Reading 高分技巧｜Original vs Updated
sections.markdown:
這類題最大的陷阱：

> **舊資訊仍然出現在文章裡。**

所以建立：

> O = Original  
> U = Updated

今天可以寫：

> O: Marketing 11  
> U: Marketing after lunch

> O: Demo 1:30  
> U: Demo 2:30

> O: Room 4  
> U: Room 7

Morning：

> unchanged

看到：

> now / revised / instead / moved / rescheduled / updated

新的資訊優先。

sections.title: ⑯ 小考解析
sections.markdown:
Q1：

後面：

> the high cost

是名詞片語。

所以：

> **Despite**

---

Q2：

後面：

> the equipment was expensive

完整：

> S + V

所以：

> **Although**

---

Q3：

Asia：

> increased

Europe：

> declined

形成對比。

所以：

> **whereas**

---

Q4：

後面：

> working

V-ing。

因此：

> **Despite working...**

不是：

> Although working ❌

在 TOEIC 標準結構題中優先選 `despite`。

---

Q5：

這裡不是對比。

意思：

> 當我確認主管是否有空時，請在這裡等。

所以：

> **while**

sections.title: ⑱ 今日錯題分類
sections.markdown:
今天繼續使用：

**G — Grammar**

`although / despite` 選錯。

**L — Listening**

沒有聽懂語音條件。

**I — Information Integration**

條件都聽懂但查錯表格。

**P — Paraphrase**

例如：

> interpret sales figures

沒有連到：

> Data Analysis。

**T — Timeline**

新舊時間判斷錯。

**E — Exception**

忽略規則例外。

今天新增：

**U — Update**

代表：

> **沒有使用最新資訊。**

例如：

看到原始：

> Room 4

就選 Room 4，

卻忽略 Email：

> moved to Room 7

就是：

**U 錯誤。**

sections.title: ⑲ 今日作業
sections.markdown:
今天單字優先掌握：

> scheduling conflict  
> check availability  
> confirm attendance  
> meeting agenda  
> afternoon session  
> meet a deadline  
> extend a deadline  
> revised schedule  
> tentative date  
> accommodate a request

文法只要建立這個超重要反射：

> **although / even though / while / whereas + S + V**

> **despite / in spite of + noun / V-ing**

不要先翻中文，先看結構。

Listening 將三段壓成：

> **Room：15 + video + 10–12 → C**

> **Julia：Tue client conflict → Wed even better → reschedule**

> **Training：afternoon + ≤170 + sales data → Data Analysis**

Reading 建立：

> **Original → Updated**

時間線：

> Marketing 11:00  
> → after lunch

> Demo 1:30  
> → 2:30

地點：

> Room 4  
> → Room 7

不變：

> Morning sessions

重新完成 Double Passage，第二次限制：

**4 分鐘。**

最後重新完成 Day 26 小考：

**2 分鐘 15 秒**

目標：

**10/10**

若今天能穩定達到 **9～10/10**，Day 27 會正式提高至 **900+ 混合推論模式**；若 Q1～Q5 錯兩題以上，後續優先回收「連接詞 vs 介系詞」；若 Q6～Q8 錯，增加多條件圖表題；若 Q9～Q10 錯，增加 `Original → Updated` 資訊追蹤題。

**Day 26 最重要的兩個反射：**

> **文法：先看空格後是「句子」還是「名詞」，再決定 although 或 despite。**

> **Reading：新資訊永遠覆蓋舊資訊；看到 `now / revised / moved / instead / updated` 要立刻更新你的答案。**

Day 27 將進入 **900+ 混合推論**：Part 4「圖表＋意圖＋下一步」三層整合、Double Passage「舊資訊／更新／例外」混合；文法進入高頻的 **條件副詞 `unless / once / as soon as / provided that / in case` 進階辨析**。
